headline: Central Bank of Nigeria mops up N3.46 trillion in liquidity auctions
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) absorbed N3.46 trillion through Open Market Operations and Treasury Bill auctions held on November 3 and 4. The bank maintained existing stop rates for Treasury Bills.
why: Central bank liquidity management is a key tool for controlling inflation and managing the money supply in emerging markets like Nigeria.
why_moved: Liquidity absorption operations affect the availability of cash in the banking system, which can influence short-term interbank lending rates.
